TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd confirms its intent to comply with CDA’s eligibility, technical, and submission requirements for the “Design, Supply, Installation and Civil Works for a City-Wide Safe-City CCTV Surveillance Network and Command & Control Centre” under the Single Stage Two Envelope procedure in line with PPRA Rules 2014, including submission to the Director (Procurement), CDA, Islamabad [CO-PROFILE].

Mandatory PASS items: We hold ISO 27001 certification for information security management, applicable to command-and-control data systems [CO-PROFILE]. We can furnish the required bid security of PKR 44 Million (2%) as a CDR/bank guarantee within our scheduled-bank facility limits [CO-PROFILE].

Methodology, programme, and HSE: Our library evidences delivery of network design, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and road/bridge works engagements, demonstrating capability to produce an integrated methodology and CPM-based 18‑month work programme aligned to multi-discipline delivery [CAP-009] [CAP-003]. We maintain a documented HSE policy with site safety plans on infrastructure deployments, supporting traffic-management planning for works on live public roads [CO-PROFILE].

PARTIAL: Key staff—our organisation includes PEC-registered engineers (4) and PMP-certified project managers (6); we will nominate the required Project Manager/Civil Works Lead/Network-Security Lead and will supplement any experience shortfall via named specialist hires/secondments at contract award [CO-PROFILE]. Video analytics—our library evidences cybersecurity and cloud infrastructure implementations; specific face/LPR analytics delivery is not yet evidenced and will be addressed through OEM partnering and demonstrated proof-of-concept during design [CAP-049] [CAP-024].

MANDATORY GAPS and closure plan: Our library does not yet evidence PEC constructor registration in category C‑B or higher, ISO 14001 certification, the required PKR 2,500M average turnover (our evidenced average is PKR 900M), a PKR 1,500M safe-city/integrated security prime contract, or owned/assured access to trenching/boring/pole-installation plant within 50 km of Islamabad [CO-PROFILE]. We will close these gaps by bidding as part of a compliant joint venture/consortium with a PEC C‑B+ civil/electrical constructor and qualified civil-works plant owner, and by adding ISO 14001-certified civil construction capability within the JV; JV financials and references will be submitted to meet CDA’s thresholds [CO-PROFILE].
